description: Quantity correction (IDEV-3266): while a correction ticket is open on a delivery, the invoice that would bill that delivery waits. One row per invoiced item (the Delivery Note stamp custom_invoiced_item_id), written only by fuelbuddy_crm.api.qc_hold.open_hold / close_hold for the QuantityCorrectionWorkflow. An Open hold stops a desk Sales Invoice whose Sales Order lines and DN window cover the delivery, and makes the 12:00 auto-invoicing job defer that Sales Order. A hold lapses on its own at Lapses At (the ticket's apply cut-off). Rows are never deleted: a closed hold stays as the record of the last episode that touched the item.

fields.description: The app invoiced item (quantity_correction_tickets.invoiced_item_id). A Delivery Note is held when its custom_invoiced_item_id equals it.
fields.label: Invoiced Item ID

fields.description: The correction ticket episode (quantity_correction_tickets.episode_key) that last opened or closed this hold.
fields.label: Ticket Episode

fields.description: When this episode opened the hold, UTC.
fields.label: Opened At (UTC)

fields.description: The ticket's apply cut-off, UTC. An Open hold stops holding invoices from this moment, even if it was never closed.
fields.label: Lapses At (UTC)

fields.description: When the ticket's end closed the hold, UTC.
fields.label: Closed At (UTC)

fields.description: How the ticket episode ended (APPLIED, FAILED, REJECTED, TIMED_OUT, NOTHING_TO_DO or SUPERSEDED).
fields.label: Close Reason

name: QC Hold
